title: VIA multi-AI handoff and GitHub delivery
purpose: Package minimal reproducible context, checksums and Git state so another AI can continue safely through an isolated GitHub branch.

steps.action: Verify changed paths and symbols match ownership and ID lease.
Record base SHA, head SHA, artifact hashes, tests, unresolved risks and rollback.
Push only code-plane allowlisted artifacts to the agent branch.
Open a reviewable PR and require human approval for Promotion.
